title: LIN-4254 piece 0: probe the auto-vivifiers and make the census compute the fake-dom consumer list
description:
## Landed

Implemented as approved and merged: [https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2321](<https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2321>) (squash `165c61e7`). The census computes the fake's consumers from an AST `ImportDeclaration` scan, run to a fixpoint through `tests/unit/helpers/` (the review's one fix, `94031902`); the header holds no hand list; `staleFileMessage` no longer points at the header; the LIN-4297 note and the LIN-4254 probe result are posted. Deviation from the plan: none beyond that fixpoint. Full history is in the task snapshots and the comment trail. The slice below is kept as the scope record (not pruned: it is the scope and acceptance, which this close-out never removes).

**Piece 0 of LIN-4254. Lands first, alone.** It sizes the move pieces and makes the fake's consumer list computed, so the 16 moves never hand-edit it.

## Slice of the approved plan

1. **Tag every flagged shape** in the 16 files as a seam, a router or an auto-vivifier, as a table in the PR description (not code). Starting point:
   * auto-vivifiers: `runner-link-surfaces:184`, `task-page-link-client-surfaces:47`, `lin-4024-home-description:70` (`Proxy`)
   * routers: `task-page-client:328/399`, `task-page-question:221-253`, `lin-3975:157`
   * seams: `close-out-client` boxes, `task-page-client:415`
2. **Probe the three auto-vivifiers on** `loadWorld` in scratch (not committed). Use the window stubs each suite already passes and the markup the server's renderer produces, not an empty body. An empty body fails on setup gaps (`app.js` throws `window.addEventListener is not a function`; `swipe.js:84` queries `.swipe-filter-select` at load). Only a `FakeDomError`, a `style` or layout read, or an unmodelled method (`click()` included: `app.js:71`, `app.js:2010`, `prompt-section.js:2612`) counts as a stop reason. Known candidates: `app.js:1679` `insertAdjacentHTML('afterend')` (only on `.dispatch-disclosure-placeholder`), `app.js:169/427` `style.display`, and `swipe.js`'s 26 `style`/layout hits. **Output:** per file, either moves, or stays listed with the API and `file:line`. Post that result as a comment on LIN-4254 so pieces 1 and 4 start from it.
3. **The census computes the fake's consumers; the header stops hand-keeping them.**
   * In `tests/unit/helpers/fake-dom.js`, replace the header's "Guard and consumers" paragraph (around `:32`) with a sentence saying the consumers are the importers the census computes. Keep `helpers/client-world.js` and `helpers/live-console-world.js` described as real importers. Keep the sentence naming `fake-dom-census.test.js` as the guard (it imports nothing, so it is not a consumer).
   * In `tests/unit/fake-dom-census.test.js`, compute the real importers of `fake-dom.js`/`client-world.js` with an AST `ImportDeclaration` scan over `tests/`, the same scope as the existing scan. It must find `lin-4293-tidy-after-repaint.test.js`. Fail if the header again hand-lists a consumer file name.
   * **Review note A:** aim that check at the consumer paragraph only, or allow exactly `fake-dom.test.js` (`:5`), `client-world.js` (`:9`, `:13`) and `live-console-world.js`. Run over the whole header, the check goes red on main. When the check fails, make the message print the computed importer set, so a reader can find it.
   * Remove the "joins the consumer list" instruction from `staleFileMessage` (`fake-dom-census.test.js:648-649`) and from the header's paragraph. Later PRs then edit only `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES`.
4. **LIN-4297:** comment there that its item 4 (derived consumer list) moved here, and that its Done-when "No hand-kept consumer list remains" is met by this piece. LIN-4297 must not delete what this piece builds.

## Testing

* A fixture test where a header that lists a consumer file goes red, and one where the pointer sentence stands goes green.
* The real census run green on main.
* `fake-dom.test.js` unchanged.
* `claude-md-line-budget` and the full unit suite green.
* The census list is unchanged by this piece (22 entries).

## Acceptance

* Shape table and probe result recorded.
* The header holds no hand-kept consumer list, and the census computes and checks the importers.
* The stale message no longer tells movers to edit the header.
* The LIN-4297 note is posted.

---

**Parent:** LIN-4254 (Move the 16 not-attempted client-test stubs onto the shared fake). This piece's starting point is the parent's approved **Implementation Plan** in LIN-4254's description, plus the builder notes in its approving Plan Review Verdict (comment `c1d9a66c-fb1a-4f25-903c-e11227c24ba7`). Follow it. Where the code shows it wrong, change course and say so in a comment on LIN-4254.

**Rules for every piece (from the plan):** "Moved" means the suite runs on `loadWorld` (`tests/unit/helpers/client-world.js` over `tests/unit/helpers/fake-dom.js`) and its private `vm.createContext` sandbox is deleted. Do not wrap the old sandbox around the fake. Slices and scripts that query the DOM at load use `loadWorld({ scripts: [] })`, then `parse(markup, document.body)`, then `world.run(source)`, as `observation-ruling-delivery` and LIN-4284 do. Router markup comes from the server's real renderer where one exists, not from hand-written HTML. Do not widen the fake. A file that hits an API the fake does not model (a `FakeDomError`, a `style` or layout read, or an unmodelled method such as `click()`) stays on `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` with a `// stop:` comment naming the API and `file:line`. A `querySelector: () => null` stub that becomes a real tree can bring dead paths to life. A test that goes red there is a finding: classify it as a real client bug, a vacuous pass or a fake gap, and list it in the PR. Never loosen the test. Test names are kept. Do not split a file to keep a count, and do not copy a fixture.

**Testing strategy (every move PR):** an assertion map; before/after sorted test names, diffed against base; one mutation per load-bearing assertion, showing it goes red; and green runs of `fake-dom-census.test.js`, `claude-md-line-budget.test.js` and the full unit suite. The census count only falls. Every remaining entry's reason is true at merge.

**Grounding commits:** plan and approving review at `b581ac92` (Surveys at `b581ac926`); LIN-4292 landed as `b389f9b0`. Re-check `git log b581ac92..origin/main -- tests/unit public` before starting.

**Session fit:** fits one session
**Plan-review due:** no — covered by LIN-4254's approving plan-review (comment c1d9a66c-fb1a-4f25-903c-e11227c24ba7, rev 2)

comments.body:
**LIN-4306 done: PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2321** (commit `8b0099d7`, branch `feat/lin-4306-census-consumer-list`, open against main, not merged).

- **Census computes the consumers.** An AST `ImportDeclaration` scan finds the importers of `fake-dom.js` and `client-world.js`. It finds `lin-4293-tidy-after-repaint.test.js`, which the hand list missed.
- **Header holds no hand list.** Its consumer paragraph names only the census and the two helpers. The check is scoped to that paragraph. The stale-file message no longer tells movers to edit the header.
- **Witnesses.** Base header: the check goes red and prints the computed set. Broken scan (skips imports): the lin-4293 test goes red. Both restored.
- **Probe (scratch):** `runner-link-surfaces`, `task-page-link-client-surfaces` and `lin-4024-home-description` all move on real markup. Result posted on LIN-4254.
- **Shape table:** the 16 files, 27 shapes, tagged seam / router / auto-vivifier, in the PR body.
- **Tests:** `fake-dom-census.test.js` 49/49. Full unit suite 23,817/23,817 pass, 0 fail.
- **CI (test.yml):** CI success, Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4 and Secret scan all pass. `mergeStateStatus` CLEAN. Not merged; merge is for review and the orchestrator.
- `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` unchanged at 22. Nothing moved in this piece.

## Review — LIN-4306

Reviewed PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2321 at head `8b0099d78833374afec314a5d5c8b2166accc721`. It changes `tests/unit/fake-dom-census.test.js` and `tests/unit/helpers/fake-dom.js`, which matches the plan's places.

CI: green on head `8b0099d7` (Unit tests, E2E 1–4, Secret scan, CI success; mergeStateStatus CLEAN). `origin/main` has since moved to `f742e5ac` (LIN-4304, `public/` and a new guard test). I re-ran on the merge of `8b0099d7` into `f742e5ac`: `npm run test:unit` 23834/23834 pass, 0 fail, exit 0.

### Checked against acceptance
- **Shape table and probe result recorded.** The table (16 files, 27 shapes) is in the PR body. The probe result is on LIN-4254 (21:02) with loader findings for pieces 1 and 4. I did not re-run the scratch probe (see ledger).
- **The header holds no hand list.** The paragraph is replaced with a pointer to the census. It keeps the `tests/`, `scripts/eval`, `scripts/code-shape` scope wording that 15061f40 fixed, so that fix is not regressed.
- **Stale message.** `staleFileMessage` no longer mentions the header or the consumer list.
- **LIN-4297 note posted** (21:02:09).
- `fake-dom.test.js` is unchanged, and the census still has 22 entries; the diff touches only the two files. No rulings exist for LIN-4306.

### Mutation checks (each reverted afterwards)
- M1, base `fake-dom.js` header restored: the paragraph check and the "joins" check both go **red**.
- M2, `ImportDeclaration` dropped from `IMPORT_LIKE`: the lin-4293 scan test goes **red**.
- M3, old stale-message wording restored: the stale-message test goes **red**.
- M4, `lin-4293-tidy-after-repaint.test.js` added to the paragraph: the paragraph check goes **red**.
- M5, `live-console-client-facts.test.js` added to the paragraph: the check stays **green**. This is the finding below.

### Finding: the computed set misses suites that reach the fake only through a helper
`computedConsumers()` counts only direct importers of `fake-dom.js` and `client-world.js`. `tests/unit/live-console-client-facts.test.js` imports only `helpers/live-console-world.js`, which imports `client-world.js`, so the census does not count it. The old hand list did ("`lin-4035-live-console-client.test.js` and `live-console-client-facts.test.js` (LIN-4285) through `loadWorld`, loaded by … `live-console-world.js`"). `lin-4035` is still counted only because it also imports `client-world.js` directly.

Compared with the old hand list, the computed set adds `lin-4293` but drops `live-console-client-facts`. So the header's claim that the consumers are the importers the census computes undercounts. A hand list naming transitive consumers can also come back without the check catching it (M5).

**Inside** scope: this is the bounded class "the census computes the fake's consumers" (description, step 3).

**Fix for close-out**, prototyped on the merged tree (49/49 green):
1. In `tests/unit/fake-dom-census.test.js` `computedConsumers()`, iterate to a fixpoint. Seed `targets` with `CONSUMED_MODULES`. After each pass, add every consumer under `tests/unit/helpers/` that is not yet in `targets`, and rescan until nothing is added. Match against `targets` instead of `CONSUMED_MODULES`.
2. In the first LIN-4306 test, add `assert.ok(consumers.includes('tests/unit/live-console-client-facts.test.js'), 'reaches client-world.js through live-console-world.js')`. Confirm it goes red with the fixpoint removed.
3. In the `fake-dom.js` header, change "the files whose imports reach this module or `helpers/client-world.js`" to "… directly or through a helper that does".

### Regression check
`git log` on both files shows the LIN-4255, 4272 and 4280–4285 history. Nothing is reverted or re-applied. Commits 591bb959 and 15061f40 edited this header; their content (stop reasons in the census, scope wording) is intact.

### Class check
The hand-kept list was in one place only (the `fake-dom.js` header). `CLAUDE.md` is covered by `claude-md-line-budget`, and the full suite is green. No sibling hand list was found under `tests/unit/helpers/`. Apart from the transitive gap above, the change is isolated.

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **Inside:** transitive consumers (`live-console-client-facts.test.js` via `live-console-world.js`) are not in the computed set. *Before the merge:* close-out makes the fix above. Exact check: the new `includes('tests/unit/live-console-client-facts.test.js')` assertion is green with the fixpoint and red without it, and M5 then goes red.
- **Inside:** the scratch probe ("all three auto-vivifiers move") is not committed, so CI does not exercise it. Pieces 1 and 4 depend on it. *Before the merge:* none needed for this piece. It is settled when LIN-4307 and LIN-4310 actually move `lin-4024-home-description`, `runner-link-surfaces` and `task-page-link-client-surfaces` with the census count falling. If one of them hits a `FakeDomError` or a `style`/layout read, the probe was wrong, and that piece records a `// stop:` instead. Recorded so close-out does not treat it as proven.
- **Inside:** CI ran on head `8b0099d7` before main moved to `f742e5ac`. *Before the merge:* re-check CI on the exact merge commit, or on the updated head after the fix. I ran the merged tree once locally (23834/23834), but that run is not an independent clean environment.

### Verdict
Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger. The work meets the acceptance criteria and the load-bearing tests are mutation-proven. Close-out must make the transitive-consumer fix (three precise edits above) and get CI green on the resulting head before merging.

## Close-out — LIN-4306

**Merged:** https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2321, squash commit `165c61e7`, pinned with `--match-head-commit 94031902`. Review verdict on record: Approve, conditional on discharging the ledger.

### Changes I made (review line → commit)
- `94031902` — review "Finding: the computed set misses suites that reach the fake only through a helper", fix steps 1–3:
  1. `computedConsumers()` in `tests/unit/fake-dom-census.test.js` now runs to a fixpoint: helpers under `tests/unit/helpers/` that reach `fake-dom.js`/`client-world.js` join the target set, and importers of them count.
  2. The first LIN-4306 test asserts `tests/unit/live-console-client-facts.test.js` is a consumer (reached through `live-console-world.js`).
  3. The `fake-dom.js` header now says "directly or through a helper that does".
- `ce7943e9` — merged `origin/main` (`f742e5ac`, LIN-4304) into the branch; no conflicts.

### Ledger
- **Inside — transitive consumers:** done. Fixpoint removed → the new `includes('…live-console-client-facts.test.js')` assertion goes red (`reaches client-world.js through live-console-world.js`). M5 (that name added to the header paragraph) → goes red, "names consumer file(s) … live-console-client-facts.test.js"; both restored. Census 49/49 on the branch; 51/51 with `claude-md-line-budget` on merged main.
- **Inside — scratch probe not committed:** nothing to do for this piece, as review said. It is settled when LIN-4307 and LIN-4310 move `lin-4024-home-description`, `runner-link-surfaces` and `task-page-link-client-surfaces`; if one hits a `FakeDomError` or `style`/layout read, that piece records a `// stop:`. Not proven by this PR.
- **Inside — CI on exact head:** re-established, see below.
- **Outside:** none, so no follow-ups filed. No rulings exist for LIN-4306. No named monitor or rollback was required by review.

### CI
`.github/workflows/test.yml` exists. On head `94031902`: Unit tests (8m43s), E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan (source) and CI success all pass; `mergeStateStatus` CLEAN at the merge. Locally on the same tree, `npm run test:unit` 23834/23834, 0 fail. The local run is not an independent clean environment.

### After the merge
Tests/header-only change; no runtime deploy or post-deploy step applies. Verified on merged main `165c61e7`: `fake-dom-census.test.js` + `claude-md-line-budget.test.js` 51/51 pass. `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` unchanged at 22.

### Description
Snapshot archive confirmed in `/snapshots` (carries the pre-prune description). I added a "Landed" stub and did not remove the slice: it is this piece's scope and acceptance, which close-out keeps. Plan implemented as approved; the only deviation is the fixpoint above.
